title: Practitioner and Patient Interpersonal skills
author: GGWXGhP7McKTXiTQc
chapter_outcomes: Describe and evaluate non-verbal communications with a focus on practitioner clothing, including a study, e.g. McKinstry and Wang (1991)
Describe and evaluate verbal communications with a focus on understanding medical terminology, including a study, e.g. McKinlay (1975)
Describe practitioner diagnosis focusing on making a diagnosis (disclosure of information, false positive and false negative diagnosis) and presenting a diagnosis
Describe and evaluate practitioner style; doctor-centred (directed) and patient-centred (sharing) consultation
Describe and evaluate the effect of practitioner style on patient satisfaction (Key study: Savage and Armstrong, 1990)
Describe delay in seeking treatment; reasons for delay, including a study, e.g. Safer et al. (1979); alternative explanations for delay, e.g. the health belief model
Describe and evaluate Munchausen syndrome versus malingering, including diagnostic features of Munchausen (essential and supporting features), including a study, e.g. Aleem and Ajarim (1995)
